title: High Court Judges Leave Pension and Privileges Amendment Order 2018

sections.shortTitle: High Court Judges Leave Pension and Privileges Amendment Order 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT'S ORDER NO
PRESIDENT'S ORDER NO. 6 OF 2018
HIGH COURT JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2018
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
9th October, 2018]
No.
F. 2(2)/2018-Pub., dated 9.10.2018.---The
following President's Order promulgated by the President is hereby published
for general information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O. No. 3 of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing:
Now,
THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan is pleased to make the following Order:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Order may be called the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges)
(Amendment) Order, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and
from the first day of July, 2018.
